sources.label: UC Davis Population Biology Graduate Group: Program Overview

english.toefl: 80 for exams before January 21, 2026; 4.5 out of 6.0 for exams on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: University minimums; programs may set higher requirements. UC Davis says to submit Duolingo only if TOEFL/IELTS options are unavailable.

applicationFee.note: $135 for U.S. applicants; $155 for international applicants. Waivers for eligible graduate preparation program participants. International applicants should confirm waiver eligibility with the program.

requirements.note: Prerequisites: one year each of introductory biology and calculus; statistics; upper-division ecology or population biology, genetics, and evolution. Admitted students may complete missing entrance requirements during their first year.

deadlines.label: General and fellowship
deadlines.note: Current 2027–28 Graduate Studies deadline table. Program says midnight; safer start of December 1 retained over central 11:59 p.m.
